_comment: Model registry. entrypoint-gpu.sh resolves MODEL_KEY -> a row. Switch models by changing MODEL_KEY in the taskdef (Terraform var model_key) + redeploy. served_name = what the Codex `model` must reference + what the client reads from /v1/models. tool_parser enables function-calling (hermes for Qwen2.5, qwen3_coder for Qwen3 — verify against your pinned vLLM). kv_cache_dtype=fp8 ~doubles concurrent-session KV headroom (works on Ampere/A10G). instance = the GPU the entry needs.

instruct-14b._note: Fits a 24GB A10G (g5.xlarge). Tool-calls correctly with Codex. Curated MCP only (32k ceiling).

coder-30b._note: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (Qwen3 MoE, 128 experts/8 active). AWQ 16.85GiB -> loads ~16.9GiB VRAM on A10G; FITS g5.2xlarge (24GB VRAM + 32GB RAM) at 16k ctx / ~1 session (0.84GiB KV @0.92 util); g6e.xlarge (L40S 48GB) for room. Standard MoE (Ampere-safe). Codex-native (qwen3_coder tool format) -> works with Codex via bin/codex-role-proxy.py. quant=none: compressed-tensors auto-detect.
